title: capy-acp spike s2-edit-linked
message: Spike test for an editor integration. First run pwd. Read README.md. Then make a small two-file edit: create docs/SPIKE.md with a one-sentence summary of what this repository is, and append the line '<!-- capy-acp spike -->' at the end of README.md. Then run git status --short and git diff --stat. Reply in at most three sentences. Do not commit, push, or open a pull request.
